companionMusicVariants.promptDirection: Create a genuinely distinct three-minute exploration and identity arrangement. Begin with unfamiliar territory and reveal the faction's signature instruments gradually. Keep the core philosophy recognizable without quoting the first track's melody; use a new tempo, harmonic center, and complete beginning-middle-end arc.

Create a genuinely distinct three-minute conflict and crisis arrangement. Put the faction's philosophy under pressure through sharper rhythm, disrupted counterpoint, and a consequential middle reversal. Do not quote the first track's melody; use a new tempo, harmonic center, and a complete dramatic arc that remains useful under gameplay.

Create a genuinely distinct three-minute alliance and aftermath arrangement. Let separate motifs negotiate, cooperate, and leave visible scars in a reflective but forward-looking resolution. Do not quote the first track's melody; use a new tempo, harmonic center, and a complete beginning-middle-end arc rather than a loop.

Create a genuinely distinct full three-minute convergence arrangement. Preserve the Indela's existing omen as history while moving into a new harmonic language of shifting perspective, divided prophecy, and paths meeting at Reath. Use a complete beginning-middle-end arc and do not end before three minutes.
